title: Formalization strategy for the Markov trace: axiomatic encoding of the three Jones properties
html: The existence proof of the Markov trace occupies §3–5 of Jones (1987). The result is taken as given rather than reproved, and only its core properties over the ground ring R_q = \mathbb{Z}[q, q^{-1}] are used. Downstream results, such as completeness on irreducibles, are derived from these properties alone.
